title: Soil Fertility And Water Management
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the capacity to receive, store and transmit energy to support plant growth."
Soil fertility is the capacity to receive, store and transmit energy to support plant growth.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a diagnostic instrument for soil fertility and basis for fertilizer recommendation; to known where and where not fertilizer is to be applied."
Soil analysis is a diagnostic instrument for soil fertility and basis for fertilizer recommendation; to known where and where not fertilizer is to be applied.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the H concentration in solution and its called the active acidity, the potential/reserve acidity is that left within the microcell."
Measurement of pH means the H concentration in solution and its called the active acidity, the potential/reserve acidity is that left within the microcell.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the pool of P that replenishes soil P immediately the soluble P is depleted."
Labile P is the pool of P that replenishes soil P immediately the soluble P is depleted.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a storm of known return period."
A design storm is a storm of known return period.
fib: ______ is a function of the experience, if acid soil use pH 4, 6 or 7 if alkaline use 6 or 7 and 9.
The choice of buffer is a function of the experience, if acid soil use pH 4, 6 or 7 if alkaline use 6 or 7 and 9.
______ is the plant and animal remains or debris at all stages of decomposition.
SOM is the plant and animal remains or debris at all stages of decomposition.
______ is a store house for organic and inorganic plant nutrients.
Soil is a store house for organic and inorganic plant nutrients.
______ is the portion of precipitation that makes its way towards the stream channels, lakes or oceans as surface or subsurface flows.
Surface runoff (or simply runoff) is the portion of precipitation that makes its way towards the stream channels, lakes or oceans as surface or subsurface flows.
______ are called humus. 1) Measurement of CO2 evolved during decomposition.
Decomposed parts are called humus. 1) Measurement of CO2 evolved during decomposition.
According to the course material, how many types of composts are there? (answer in figures)

There are two types of composts: (а) Farmyard compost which is obtained from animal excreta and plant residues. (b) Town compost which is obtained by decomposition of kitchen wastes and garbage of towns and cities.
